modules.name: Web Panel
modules.description: Web interface used by Raghuvir Admin and Assigned Person roles.

modules.name: Mobile App
modules.description: Mobile interface used by Society Manager, Resident and Watchman roles.

requirements.title: Raghuvir Admin work on Web Panel
requirements.description: Raghuvir Admin (head office staff) uses the Web Panel for project setup, Society Managers, complaint control and announcements.

requirements.title: Assigned Person fixes complaints
requirements.description: Assigned Person (Raghuvir staff or service team) uses the Web Panel to fix a complaint and mark it Fixed.

requirements.title: Society Manager work on Mobile App
requirements.description: Society Manager (Secretary or President) uses the Mobile App to approve residents and check complaints, documents and hall approvals.

requirements.title: Resident complaints, bookings and visitors
requirements.description: Resident (flat customer) uses the Mobile App for complaints, bookings and visitors.

requirements.title: Watchman visitor handling
requirements.description: Watchman (gate security) uses the Mobile App for the visitor list, walk-in entry, and entry and exit time.

rules.title: Raghuvir Admin visibility
rules.description: Raghuvir Admin can see all projects, or only the projects given to them.

rules.title: Assigned Person visibility
rules.description: Assigned Person can see only the complaints given to them.

rules.title: Society Manager sees own project only
rules.description: Society Manager can see only their own project.

rules.title: Resident visibility
rules.description: Resident can see their own flat and the project's shared info.

rules.title: Watchman sees today's visitors only
rules.description: Watchman can see only their own project's visitors, for today only.
